youtube.description:
Wrote the IIM B UGAT on 15 Nov? Get your exact score in under a minute with our free calculator.

Calculator: https://register.ipmcareer.com/response-v1

How to use it:
1. Log in with the link IIM B shared and copy your response sheet link from the address bar.
2. Open the calculator and fill in your mobile, email, category and city.
3. Paste the link and tap Analyse My Score. Link not opening? Save the page as HTML and use Upload file (not a PDF).
4. See your QADI, LR and VARC scores, total out of 180, accuracy, marks lost to negatives and a question by question map.

Marking: +3 for a right answer, -1 for a wrong one, 0 for skipped.
This is your raw score. IIM B standardises scores and uses percentiles for the shortlist, so official numbers can differ.

Send this to a friend who wrote it too.

#Shorts #IIMBUGAT #IIMBangalore #IPMCareers
